accessory.message: Service admin is routed by Traefik but has no healthcheck; traffic starts as soon as the container starts
Traefik labels in labels are used on Kubernetes; on Swarm Traefik only reads deploy.labels
Service postgres is updated with Recreate because it mounts volume postgres_data (ReadWriteOnce)
Kubernetes does not copy the image's files into an empty volume mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data (Docker does)
accessory.hint: Seed the volume from the entrypoint, or mount a subdirectory the image does not ship.

accessory.message: volume postgres_data is stored in the claim postgres-data
